author: National Geographic
description:
Cascading more than 2,500 feet (762 meters), Gocta waterfall, near the village of Cocachimba in northern Peru, is one of the world’s tallest waterfalls. It's just one of the incredible sights that visitors can discover in northern Peru, a region gaining further interest thanks to the archaeological work underway at the nearby ruins of Kuélap.
